name: Slack
description: Communications and messaging: team messaging platform with channels, DMs, canvases and an extensive app platform.
access_notes: Anyone can create a Slack app self-serve at api.slack.com/apps and install it to a free workspace to get bot/user tokens; some workspaces require admin approval for installs.
mcp_notes: Official Slack MCP server at https://mcp.slack.com/mcp (JSON-RPC over Streamable HTTP, OAuth, requires a registered Slack app). Composio SLACK toolkit: 167 tools, 9 triggers, Composio-managed OAuth2.

evidence.note: Slack apps are installed with a v2 OAuth 2.0 flow yielding bot/user access tokens with scopes.
Web API authenticated via bearer token; 'Register your application' at api.slack.com/apps is self-serve.
Official Slack MCP server at https://mcp.slack.com/mcp with OAuth and tools for search, messaging, canvases, users.
Composio SLACK toolkit: OAuth2, Composio-managed app, 167 tools, 9 triggers.
Events API delivers workspace events to an app's request URL (webhook-style); Socket Mode offers WebSocket delivery.
